**Your files. Your basket. Your rules.** — first public release of Panaru, the native client for your self-hosted [Gokapi](https://github.com/Forceu/Gokapi) server. Pick a file, get the link.

### 🇬🇧 Download

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Android 8+** | `Panaru-0.1.0-android.apk` | Allow installs from your browser / file manager when Android asks. |
| **macOS 14+** (Apple Silicon & Intel) | `Panaru-0.1.0-macOS.zip` | Unzip and move *Panaru* to Applications. The app is not notarized yet: the first time, right-click → **Open**, or go to *System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway*. |
| **Linux** (GTK 4.14+, libadwaita 1.5+) | `Panaru-0.1.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` · `…-aarch64.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./install.sh --prebuilt` (installs to `~/.local`). Needs a Secret Service keyring (GNOME Keyring, KWallet, KeePassXC). |

You need a **Gokapi ≥ 2.0.1** server and an API key with the *Upload* permission (*View*, *Delete* and *Download* are optional). Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

**What's inside:** multiple servers with connection check · API keys in the system keychain · chunked streaming uploads, even for huge files · expiry, download limit and password · link copied automatically + notification · history synced with the server · delete from the server · Android Share Sheet · macOS drag & drop on window, Dock and menu bar, Finder services · Linux drag & drop and "Open with".

### 🇮🇹 Download

| Piattaforma | File | Note |
|---|---|---|
| **Android 8+** | `Panaru-0.1.0-android.apk` | Consenti l'installazione dal browser / file manager quando Android lo chiede. |
| **macOS 14+** (Apple Silicon e Intel) | `Panaru-0.1.0-macOS.zip` | Estrai e sposta *Panaru* in Applicazioni. L'app non è ancora notarizzata: la prima volta clic destro → **Apri**, oppure *Impostazioni di Sistema → Privacy e sicurezza → Apri comunque*. |
| **Linux** (GTK 4.14+, libadwaita 1.5+) | `Panaru-0.1.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` · `…-aarch64.tar.gz` | Estrai ed esegui `./install.sh --prebuilt` (installa in `~/.local`). Serve un portachiavi Secret Service (GNOME Keyring, KWallet, KeePassXC). |

Serve un server **Gokapi ≥ 2.0.1** e una chiave API con il permesso *Upload* (*View*, *Delete* e *Download* facoltativi). I checksum sono in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

*Made with care, inspired by Sicily.* — An app by [Piratepixel](https://www.piratepixel.it/#panaru)
